items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee corrects the interviewer regarding who brought Dominique Gaumont into the band, indicating awareness of his involvement but no direct personal or professional relationship described.

ctx.x: Yeah, March, and then I left him – yeah, actually, because I left him in April.
Which is an interesting record. Apparently on that record he brought in Dominique Gaumont and he brought in Azar Lawrence.
He didn’t bring them in. The band – Mtume [James Forman] brought them in.
